rounds.text: Gayatri Highways Ltd carries severe structural risks that render its headline low valuation entirely illusory [E1]. The company operates with a deeply negative book value of ₹ -7.17, resulting in a negative price-to-book ratio of -0.26x [E2]. Furthermore, core profitability is actively deteriorating over a multi-year horizon, evidenced by an operating margin that worsened from -7% to -10% in Mar 2026 [E22]. Operational efficiency severely lags behind industry standards, delivering a return on assets of just 2.07% against a sector benchmark of 7.1% [E8]. Compounding these fundamental distress signals, the company provides zero returns to shareholders with a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4], and the equity languishes near the bottom of its annual range at just 11% of its 52-week span [E5]. Conceded: the quarterly operating margin showed dramatic single-quarter improvement to 6% in Mar 2026 compared to -176% in the year-ago quarter [E23].
